name: write (Own Voice)
provides: The places a post can go with their limits, the lines a draft must follow, and a check on a finished draft: does it fit, does it sound like the person, is any of it stock. No model, no network, no sign-in
asks: never: it only reads and checks the drafts you hand it
migrationDebt: Raw tool installation/execution and third-party SDK ownership must move to published BYOKit capabilities; this manifest records current behavior, not an approved bypass.
